title: When Does LLM-Serving Scheduler Adaptation Matter? Action Opportunity and Causal Headroom in Production-Derived Replay (Reproducibility Package)
description: This is the reproducibility package containing code, experimental results, and manuscript sources to accompany the paper 'When Does LLM-Serving Scheduler Adaptation Matter? Action Opportunity and Causal Headroom in Production-Derived Replay'. It contains the frozen result CSVs, figure-plotting scripts, and LaTeX sources required to verify and build the findings of the study.
